planar-motion.def: A particle in the plane with position $\mathbf{r}(t) = \left\langle x(t), y(t) \right\rangle$ has velocity $\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{r}'$, acceleration $\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{v}'$ and speed $\sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2}$. The displacement vector over $[a, b]$ is $\int_a^b \mathbf{v}(t)\,dt = \mathbf{r}(b) - \mathbf{r}(a)$; the total distance traveled is the integral of the speed, $\int_a^b \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2}\,dt$.
